mapper.select: /* AppAdminSafetyMapper.selectInspectionList */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , S.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.CHKPT_CD AS chkptCd , A.CHKPT_NM AS chkptNm , C.CHKLST_TYPE AS chkLstType , COUNT(DISTINCT D.WORK_DATE) AS inspectDayCnt , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN D.INSPECT_ANSWER_TYPE = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS defectiveResultCnt FROM TB_CHKPT_TYPE_MGMT A INNER JOIN TB_SITE S ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = S.SITE_CD ) INNER JOIN TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ITEM C ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND A.CHKLST_TYPE = C.CHKLST_TYPE ) LEFT JOIN TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ANSWER D ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = D.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = D.SITE_CD AND A.CHKPT_CD = D.CHKPT_CD AND C.INSPECT_ITEM_CD = D.INSPECT_ITEM_CD AND SUBSTR(D.WORK_DATE, 1, 6) = #{workMonth} ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY A.CMPNY_CD , A.SITE_CD , S.SITE_NM , A.CHKPT_CD , A.CHKPT_NM , C.CHKLST_TYPE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT D.WORK_DATE) > 0 ORDER BY A.CHKLST_TYPE, A.CHKPT_CD

/* AppAdminSafetyMapper.selectInspectionDetailAnswers */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.CHKPT_CD AS chkptCd , B.INSPECT_ITEM_CD AS inspectItemCd , B.INSPECT_ITEM_SUBJ AS inspectItemSubj , C.WORK_DATE AS workDate , CASE WHEN C.INSPECT_ANSWER_TYPE = 'Y' THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS inspectAnswerType , C.ANSWER_DESC AS answerDesc , C.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'FILE_NAME', C.FILE_MGMT_CD, NULL) AS fileName , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'FILE_PATH', C.FILE_MGMT_CD, NULL) AS filePath FROM TB_CHKPT_TYPE_MGMT A INNER JOIN TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ITEM B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.CHKLST_TYPE = B.CHKLST_TYPE ) INNER JOIN TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ANSWER C ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = C.SITE_CD AND A.CHKPT_CD = C.CHKPT_CD AND B.INSPECT_ITEM_CD = C.INSPECT_ITEM_CD AND C.WORK_DATE LIKE CONCAT(#{workMonth}, '%') ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.CHKLST_TYPE = #{chkLstType} AND A.CHKPT_CD = #{chkptCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN C.INSPECT_ANSWER_TYPE = 'N' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , C.WORK_DATE DESC , B.SORT_IDX , B.INSPECT_ITEM_CD
mapper.sql: A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.PROCESS_CD AS processCd , C.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS processNm , A.RISK_TYPE_CD AS riskTypeCd , D.RISK_TYPE_NM AS riskTypeNm , A.HAZARD_CD AS hazardCd , CASE WHEN A.HAZARD_CD = 'self' THEN A.ASSESSMENT_DESC ELSE E.HAZARD_NM END AS hazardNm , A.ASSESSMENT_CD AS assessmentCd , A.ASSESSMENT_STATUS AS assessmentStatus , B.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS assessmentStatusNm , A.INIT_LIKELIHOOD_SCORE AS initLikelihoodScore , A.INIT_SEVERITY_SCORE AS initSeverityScore , A.INIT_RISK_LV AS initRiskLv , A.INIT_DESC AS initDesc , A.INIT_ASSESSOR_ID AS initAssessorId , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.INIT_ASSESSOR_ID, NULL) AS initAssessorNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.INIT_ASSESS_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS initAssessDate , A.INIT_FILE_MGMT_CD AS initFileMgmtCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'FILE_PATH', A.INIT_FILE_MGMT_CD, NULL) AS initFilePath , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'FILE_NAME', A.INIT_FILE_MGMT_CD, NULL) AS initFileName , A.REVAL_DATE AS revalDate , A.REVAL_BEFORE_DESC AS revalBeforeDesc , A.REVAL_LIKELIHOOD_SCORE AS revalLikelihoodScore , A.REVAL_SEVERITY_SCORE AS revalSeverityScore , A.REVAL_RISK_LV AS revalRiskLv , A.REVAL_DESC AS revalDesc , A.REVAL_ASSESSOR_ID AS revalAssessorId , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.REVAL_ASSESSOR_ID, NULL) AS revalAssessorNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.REVAL_ASSESS_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS revalAssessDate

FROM TB_RISK_ASSESSMENT A INNER JOIN ( SELECT SV.SYST_VAL_D_CD , SV.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D SV WHERE SV.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS011' AND SV.USE_YN = 'Y' ) B ON (A.ASSESSMENT_STATUS = B.SYST_VAL_D_CD) INNER JOIN ( SELECT BV.BAIM_VAL_D_CD , BV.BAIM_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_BAIM_VAL_D BV WHERE BV.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND BV.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM002' AND BV.USE_YN = 'Y' ) C ON (A.PROCESS_CD = C.BAIM_VAL_D_CD) INNER JOIN TB_RISK_TYPE D ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = D.CMPNY_CD AND A.RISK_TYPE_CD = D.RISK_TYPE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_SITE_HAZARD E ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND A.RISK_TYPE_CD = E.RISK_TYPE_CD AND A.HAZARD_CD = E.HAZARD_CD )
